name: focus-friendly
description: Make dense information and complex work easier to understand, navigate, and act on.

interface.shortDescription: Understand dense information one layer at a time.
interface.longDescription: Focus Friendly adapts reading, research, learning, planning, and project work into clear layers with visible context and concrete next steps. It is designed for people who experience attention, working-memory, or reading barriers, while remaining useful to anyone facing information overload.
defaultPrompt: Make this easier to understand one layer at a time.
Help me learn this concept with one clear example.
Reorient me and give me the single next step.
